title: REST API Design
description: Production REST API design reference covering resources, URIs, methods, status codes, representations, errors, pagination, filtering, caching, conditional requests, idempotency, asynchronous operations, authentication, authorization, versioning, documentation, testing, observability, and evolution.

subtopics.title: Resource Modeling & URI Design
subtopics.description: Model stable domain resources and relationships, not database tables or UI actions. URIs identify resources; representations describe their current state.

callouts.title: Commands Are Sometimes Honest
callouts.text: When an operation does not map cleanly to CRUD, model a command/job/subresource deliberately rather than forcing misleading PUT/PATCH semantics.

subtopics.title: Methods, Safety & Idempotency
subtopics.description: GET/HEAD are safe; PUT and DELETE are idempotent by intended effect; POST and PATCH are not automatically idempotent. Method semantics drive retries, caching, and intermediaries.

rows: Partial update under defined patch format

callouts.title: GET Must Not Cause Meaningful State Change
callouts.text: Browsers, crawlers, caches, and prefetchers invoke safe methods automatically. Do not use GET for logout, deletion, payment, or mutation.

subtopics.title: Status Codes & Problem Details
subtopics.description: Use protocol status codes consistently and return a stable machine-readable error contract with safe detail, field issues, and correlation.

callouts.title: Do Not Return 200 for Every Outcome
callouts.text: HTTP status drives clients, caches, proxies, retries, monitoring, and operations. Keep domain codes in the body while preserving transport semantics.

subtopics.title: Representations & Content Negotiation
subtopics.description: Declare request and response media types, character encoding where relevant, timestamps, units, null/missing semantics, and links. Negotiate only formats the API operates well.

callouts.title: Numbers Need Domain Semantics
callouts.text: Document precision, scale, units, currency, rounding, time zone, and timestamp format. JSON number alone is not an adequate money or identifier contract.

subtopics.title: Pagination, Filtering, Sorting & Search
subtopics.description: Bound collection size, use cursor pagination for changing ordered data where possible, allowlist filters/sorts, and return navigation metadata without exposing internal query syntax.

callouts.title: Cursors Are Untrusted Input
callouts.text: Sign or validate structure, reapply authorization and filters, expire if needed, and use deterministic unique ordering to prevent gaps or duplicates.

subtopics.title: Versioning & Backward-Compatible Evolution
subtopics.description: Prefer additive fields and tolerant readers, measure field/client usage, deprecate with dates and migration guidance, and version only when a semantic break cannot be staged compatibly.

callouts.title: A URL Version Does Not Solve Migration
callouts.text: You still need ownership, support windows, telemetry, documentation, client testing, data migration, and removal criteria.

subtopics.title: ETags, Preconditions & Lost-Update Prevention
subtopics.description: Validators enable cache revalidation and optimistic concurrency. Require If-Match on updates where overwriting a newer representation would be unsafe.

codeBlocks.code:
GET /documents/42
→ ETag: "v7"

PUT /documents/42
If-Match: "v7"
Content-Type: application/json

→ 204 No Content + ETag: "v8"
→ 412 Precondition Failed if current is not v7

callouts.title: Last Write Wins Is a Policy, Not a Default
callouts.text: Choose conflict semantics explicitly. Version fields, ETags, merge rules, or commands may be more appropriate for collaborative or invariant-heavy resources.

subtopics.title: Idempotency Keys & Retry Contracts
subtopics.description: For retryable POST-like operations, bind a client-generated key to caller, normalized request, processing state, and canonical response for a documented retention window.

codeBlocks.code:
POST /payments
Idempotency-Key: 6a08c9a8-...

Same key + same request → same canonical outcome
Same key + different request → 409 conflict
Concurrent same key → serialize or return in-progress result

callouts.title: Idempotency Storage Must Be Atomic with the Effect
callouts.text: If the payment commits but the key record does not, retries duplicate the effect. Design the authoritative transaction or recovery protocol around that ambiguity.

subtopics.title: Asynchronous Jobs, Polling & Caching
subtopics.description: Return 202 with a monitor resource for accepted work that is not complete. Publish explicit job states, cancellation policy, retry guidance, expiry, and final result links.

callouts.title: Cache User-Specific Data Carefully
callouts.text: Set private/no-store or correct shared-cache keys and Vary behavior. Never let authorization headers, cookies, or tenant context leak one user's representation to another.

subtopics.title: Authentication, Authorization & Abuse Controls
subtopics.description: Authenticate through a defined session/token scheme, authorize action and object on every request, validate input, bound bodies/work, rate-limit abuse, and minimize response data.

codeBlocks.code:
Edge: TLS, header/body limits, normalized proxy trust
Identity: validate issuer/audience/signature/session
Policy: action + object + tenant + current state
Execution: parameterized stores, SSRF/path allowlists, deadlines
Abuse: quotas, concurrency, pagination and expensive-query budgets

callouts.title: Do Not Trust Client-Supplied Ownership
callouts.text: Resolve caller and resource relationship from trusted server state. Hidden UI controls and unguessable IDs are not authorization.

subtopics.title: OpenAPI, Examples & Client Contracts
subtopics.description: Keep an executable API description aligned with behavior, including schemas, parameters, auth, errors, examples, callbacks/webhooks, and deprecation. Validate generated clients from packaged artifacts.

codeBlocks.code:
paths:
  /orders/{orderId}:
    get:
      operationId: getOrder
      parameters:
        - in: path
          name: orderId
          required: true
          schema: { type: string }
      responses:
        '200': { description: Order representation }
        '404': { description: Not found }

callouts.title: Generated Documentation Is Not API Design
callouts.text: Review names, semantics, examples, errors, security, and evolution with consumers. Generation prevents drift only when CI compares or derives the deployed contract.

subtopics.title: Testing, Observability & Production Checklist
subtopics.description: Test domain rules, request/response contracts, real datastore semantics, authentication/authorization, retries, concurrency, rate limits, proxy behavior, and compatibility.

codeBlocks.code:
Observe: route template, method, status, latency, request/response size
Trace: server span + downstream calls; propagate standard context
Log: request/trace ID, safe actor/resource IDs, decision/outcome
Never label metrics by raw URL/user ID or log credentials/payloads

callouts.title: Production Checklist
callouts.text: Model resources honestly, honor method/status semantics, bound collections, publish stable errors, prevent lost updates, define idempotency, secure every object/action, document with OpenAPI, test compatibility and failure, redact telemetry, and publish ownership/support policy.
